battle.name: 平壤之戰
battle.brief: 顯慶六年（六百六十一年）春，百濟遺民反唐，熊津失守；唐高宗遣契苾何力、楊萬春率漢軍與鐵勒騎兵東來，擊破復國軍後合圍平壤道要衝安市城。圍城遇大雪，海運糧道斷絕，士卒僵凍死者過半，唐軍引還，安市未下。卡面羅馬短劍不在此戰場上，卻可與唐軍步槊、環首刀及高句麗鐵札甲對照。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方有四支力量：唐朝的中央軍、高句麗王國的守軍、百濟復國軍，以及受高句麗召喚南下的靺鞨騎兵；新羅站在唐軍一側，但更多是接應與供糧的角色。唐軍方面，行動由唐高宗下詔，兵部與尚書省調度，行軍總管契苾何力節制全線，下轄漢軍與鐵勒（契苾）等蕃部附庸騎兵；糧秣不是就地徵取，而是由登州、萊州沿海船運至熊津、鴨綠水一線，再轉陸路運往安市，隊伍一旦離開海岸，補給就全靠這條脆弱的鏈條。高句麗方面，寶藏王高藏坐鎮平壤，實權在莫離支男建與留王男產手中，全國兵賦與城邑分屯於鴨綠水以北、以平壤為中心的高山山城體系，守城靠弓弩、落石與拒馬，城下有熟悉山徑的步卒與突騎可用。百濟復國軍由扶餘隆自稱百濟王後收攏故地殘民，與高句麗將領渾比興、高延等合流，目標是收復熊津、突城、道城，切斷唐軍後路。靺鞨部眾以騎兵的形式加入高句麗聯軍，作用是壓住唐軍的海上糧道與側翼。
countriesEn: The belligerents were four: the central army of the Tang court, the defenders of the Goguryeo kingdom, the restored Baekje army, and Mohe cavalry summoned south by Goguryeo; Silla stood on the Tang side, though mainly as a source of reception and supply. On the Tang side the operation was ordered by Emperor Gaozong and moved by the Ministry of War and the Department of State Affairs, with the itinerant commander Qibi Heli holding the whole line, Chinese troops marching under Tiele (Qibi) and other tribal auxiliaries whose horsemen were the mobile arm. Supplies were not taken from the country: they sailed from Dengzhou and Laizhou along the coast to Kumgang and the lower Yalu, and were then moved overland to Ansi; once a column left the coast, everything rested on that fragile chain. On the Goguryeo side, King Gochang, called Baocang, sat at Pyongyang, while real power was held by the great marquis Naman-gun and the marquis of the capital Naman-chan; the state's military registers and walled towns were distributed across a system of mountain fortresses centred on Pyongyang north of the Yalu, defended with bows, crossbows, stones and chevaux-de-frise, with foot soldiers who knew the mountain paths and raiding cavalry at hand. The restored Baekje force, gathered by Buyeo Long after he proclaimed himself king of Baekje, absorbed the surviving population of the old country and joined hands with Goguryeo commanders such as Hun Biseong and Go Yeon; its object was to retake Kumgang, Tucheng and Daocheng and cut the Tang rear. Mohe contingents entered the Goguryeo coalition in the form of horsemen, whose task was to press the Tang sea-borne supply line and cover the flank.
people: 指揮唐軍的是契苾何力。他是鐵勒契苾部的首領，唐初內屬，賜姓契苾，歷任左金牙衛大將軍、驃騎大將軍，顯慶年間以行軍大總管身份統兵東來，是安市城下唯一能同時兼顧攻城與打援的人。他倚仗的是鐵勒騎兵的速度：先以騎兵在城郊擊散高句麗與靺鞨的援軍，再回身合圍安市。與他並肩的是唐將楊萬春，攻城與掃清外圍多出其手，兩人分兵處置，一部專事攻城，一部專防高句麗與百濟的合擊。坐鎮後方的劉仁願是唐廷派在熊津、平壤一線的主將，負責接應海運糧船與維持前線補給，這一場敗後他被追究，說明唐廷的追責只落在後方調度上，戰場上死的人反而無人問津。高句麗方面，真正握有決策權的是莫離支男建，他以安市為支點號令全國兵馬；其弟男產被派往安市城外與高句麗主力匯合，兩人合兵之後，抵抗才從守城變成有反攻能力的攻勢。百濟那邊，扶餘隆是復國的旗幟，他以百濟王的名號號召故地民眾，渾比興與高延則是實際握兵者。另一端的支點是新羅王金春秋：他早在顯慶五年便遣使入唐求援，滅百濟之役中出兵助唐，此役中他承擔接應與供應，是唐朝在東南方向唯一不必長途後勤的盟軍。
peopleEn: The Tang commander was Qibi Heli, chief of the Qibi branch of the Tiele. Having submitted to the Tang in the early years of the empire and taken the surname Qibi, he served as commander of the Left Golden Tooth Guard and as a general of the Flying Cavalry, and in the years of Xianqing he led the expedition east as itinerant commander-in-chief; he was the one man in the field able to press the siege and cover the approaches at the same time. What he relied on was the speed of the Tiele horse: first the cavalry broke up the Goguryeo and Mohe relief force in the suburbs, and only then did the columns close in on Ansi. Beside him worked the Tang general Yang Wanchun, who took charge of the assault and of clearing the surroundings, the two dividing the labour, one column devoted to the siege, the other to guarding against a combined Goguryeo and Baekje attack. In the rear sat Liu Renyuan, the Tang commander on the Kumgang and Pyongyang line, responsible for receiving the grain ships and keeping the front supplied; after the defeat he was the one called to account, which shows that the court's reckoning fell on the logistics officer while nobody asked after the men who had done the dying. On the Goguryeo side the real decisions were made by the great marquis Naman-gun, who used Ansi as the pivot of the entire national effort; his brother Naman-chan was sent out to join the main Goguryeo force in front of the city, and once the two commands were joined the resistance changed from a passive defence into something able to counterattack. On the Baekje side Buyeo Long was the banner, calling the old people of the country back under the title of king of Baekje, while Hun Biseong and Go Yeon held the actual soldiers. The other anchor was King Kim Chunchun of Silla, who had sent envoys to the Tang court as early as the fifth year of Xianqing, had marched with Tang in the destruction of Baekje, and here provided reception and supply, the one ally whose supply lines did not have to travel a thousand li.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬短劍不在東亞的戰場上，它的用途是給這場戰役一個對照的尺度。羅馬短劍約西元前一世紀定型，是軍團步兵在密集陣線中的專用兵器：刃長不足半公尺，握柄供單手握持，重心貼近手部，刺出之後不易被對方的長刀纏住；但要成陣使用，必須先有盾牌的遮蔽與節奏的配合，否則它比長刀更難自保。唐軍的對應位置不在劍，而在槊與刀：環首刀是直身單刃，環形護手兼顧刺與劈；步槊長逾兩丈，列陣時遮蔽身體，側面能抵住騎兵衝撞。攻城一方真正吃重的是器械：唐軍自遼東運來雲梯、巢車與投石機，壓制城頭弓弩；車兵以槊為長槍，列拒馬成障。圍城必須先清掉援軍，這一點唐軍做到了，但器械不能解決糧道被雪封住的問題。高句麗守城的裝備偏向防禦：鐵札甲、札葉甲遮擋箭矢，長角弓與重弩仰射，拋石與落木打擊貼近城牆的敵軍；百濟與靺鞨的騎兵配弓刀，靠機動作戰打唐軍側翼。運輸方面，唐軍依賴海船，糧秣自山東半島沿海北運，船只與登陸點決定了唐軍能走多遠，也決定了它不能在東北的雪原上久戰。若說短刺劍與環首刀同屬單刃直身的短兵，功能相近，但兩者之間並無直接承接的證據；羅馬短劍問世於西元前一世紀，比此役早七百餘年。
kitsEn: The card's Roman short sword was never present on an East Asian battlefield; its use here is to give the campaign a standard of comparison. The gladius took shape around the first century before the common era and was the dedicated weapon of legionary infantry in the dense line: the blade was less than half a metre long, the grip fitted one hand, and the point of balance sat close to the hand, so that after a thrust it was hard for an opponent's long knife to catch and hold it. Used singly it was hopeless, and it worked only in array, behind the cover of shields and in rhythm; otherwise it was harder to defend with than a long sword. The Tang counterpart lay not in the sword but in the spear and the knife: the ring-pommel knife is a straight single-edged blade with a ring-shaped guard, used for both the thrust and the cut, and the foot spear exceeds two zhang, screening the body in formation and turning a charging horseman when brought to bear sideways. What really bore weight on the attacking side was machinery: the Tang brought cloud ladders, observation towers and traction trebuchets up from Liao-dong to shoot down the defenders on the wall, and their chariot troops formed ranks of chevaux-de-frise with their spears. To take a walled city one had first to destroy the relief force, and the Tang did that, but no machine could solve the problem of the supply line being sealed by snow. The Korean defenders were equipped for defence above all: iron plate and lamellar armour turned aside arrows, long horn bows and heavy crossbows fired upward, and stones and timber were dropped on enemy troops pressed against the walls; the Baekje and Mohe horsemen carried bow and knife and fought by manoeuvre against the Tang flank. In transport the Tang depended on the sea, with grain sailing north from the Shandong peninsula along the coast; the number of ships and the landing places decided how far the army could advance, and equally that it could not stand through the winter on the snowy plains of the north-east. The short thrusting sword and the ring-pommel knife belong to the same family of straight single-edged close weapons and are functionally close, but there is no evidence of any direct descent from one to the other; the Roman blade appeared in the first century before the common era, more than seven hundred years before this campaign.
tactics: 唐軍的戰術是典型的圍城加打援。契苾何力先以鐵勒騎兵在安市城外迎擊高句麗與靺鞨的援軍，把對方的援軍打散在城郊，然後才分兵合圍安市城，企圖以最短時間拿下安市，打通通往平壤的道路。攻城本身依靠器械與工兵：築土山逼近城牆，土山高度超過城堞，以其上的弓弩與投石機壓制城頭守軍，再以雲梯近壁。但唐軍真正的弱點在補給鏈條：糧船自山東半島出發，沿海岸北上至熊津，卸貨之後再以車馬陸運到安市；海運不能停，車隊一停，圍城的兵就會挨餓。入冬之後遼東大雪，海面封凍、陸路積雪，車隊與船隊同時斷絕，糧道遂不通。撤退時隊伍必須丟棄輜重與攻城器械，先保人，序列一旦拉長就會被高句麗的突騎咬住。與此同時，高句麗與百濟的聯軍並沒有龜縮在城裡：他們以突騎切斷唐軍與海岸之間的道路，用夜襲消耗唐軍的體力，把唐軍拖進遲滯的消耗戰；高句麗還從平壤方向增援安市，試圖在唐軍最疲憊的時候反轉攻守。策劃者的錯誤，是把冬季的攻勢當成秋季的攻勢來計算。
tacticsEn: The Tang method was the classic siege plus destruction of the relief. Qibi Heli first met the Goguryeo and Mohe relief force outside Ansi with the Tiele horse, scattering the enemy's reinforcements in the suburbs of the city, and only then divided his columns to invest Ansi, hoping to take the city in the shortest possible time and open the road to Pyongyang. The assault itself depended on machinery and engineers: they built a ramp of earth up against the wall, raised it above the battlements, drove the defenders from the top with bows and stones, and only then brought the ladders to the base. But the real weakness lay in the supply chain, for the grain ships sailed from the Shandong peninsula north along the coast to Kumgang, and the cargo had to be carted from the landing place to Ansi; the shipping could not stop, and the moment the carts stopped the besiegers began to starve. After the first snow of winter the sea froze, the roads filled with drift, the cart train and the shipping were cut at the same moment, and the grain route was severed. On the way out the column had to abandon baggage and siege engines, put the men first, and once the column stretched out it was bitten at by Goguryeo raiders. At the same time the Korean and Baekje coalition did not sit inside the walls: mounted raiders cut the road between the Tang army and the coast, night raids wore down the soldiers, and the campaign was dragged into a war of attrition; Goguryeo also sent reinforcements toward Ansi from Pyongyang, hoping to reverse the situation at the moment the Tang were most exhausted. The planners' error was to calculate a winter offensive as though it were an autumn one.
data: 可核對的數字集中在《資治通鑑》卷二百一與兩《唐書》的高句麗傳。第一，時間：百濟復國在顯慶六年（六百六十一年）正月，唐軍救援與合圍安市在同年夏秋，撤退在同年冬；咸亨元年（六百六十二年）正月，唐高宗下詔罷兵，遼東與百濟一線全線收縮。第二，兵力：安市之戰的外線打援，唐方以契苾何力所部漢軍及鐵勒騎兵為主，數目沒有確切記載；高句麗與靺鞨的援軍，記載作十五萬，屬史書的概數，實際集結當然有出入；安市城內守軍則無從得知。第三，損失：圍城因糧道斷絕而崩潰，《資治通鑑》記唐軍士卒僵凍、死者過半，沒有留下確切人數；僵凍死者過半若放在當時圍城部隊的規模上推算，是那年東北戰線上最重的一次兵力耗損，但這只是量級而不是統計。第四，後續：李勣於顯慶末年至龍朔年間再伐高句麗，集兵十五萬，於六百六十八年九月十二日拔平壤，其後分其境為九都督府、四十二州、一百縣；從六百六十一年的敗退到六百六十八年城破，前後七年。第五，地理與距離：安市在平壤西南通往遼東的要道上，確切位置有兩說，一說在遼東城一帶，一說在今漢江下游忠清南道安城、芝南一帶；平壤在鴨綠水下游，距遼東城五百餘里；海運自登州、萊州起運，順風數日可抵熊津，逆風與結冰則寸步難行。第六，時間成本：一次圍城的成敗，取決的不是攻城技藝，而是糧船能否在雪季之前完成一個來回。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked sit mainly in the Zizhi Tongjian, juan 201, and in the Goguryeo chapters of the two Tang histories. First, chronology: the Baekje rising came in the first month of the sixth year of Xianqing (661); the Tang relief and the investment of Ansi ran through the summer and autumn of that year, and the withdrawal came in the winter; in the first month of the first year of Xianheng (662) Emperor Gaozong ordered the troops disbanded, and the whole Liao-dong and Baekje line was contracted. Second, strength: for the battle outside the walls the Tang fielded the Chinese troops of Qibi Heli together with the Tiele horse, and no figure is given; the Goguryeo and Mohe relief is recorded as one hundred and fifty thousand, a summary figure of the kind historians use rather than a head count, and the garrison inside Ansi cannot be known at all. Third, losses: the siege collapsed because the supply line was cut, and the Zizhi Tongjian records that the soldiers froze and that more than half of them died, with no exact number left behind; if more than half of a besieging column of that order froze to death, it was the heaviest single loss the north-eastern front suffered in that year, but that is an order of magnitude and not a statistic. Fourth, the sequel: Li Ji returned to the offensive from the last years of Xianqing through the Yong days, mustering one hundred and fifty thousand men, and Pyongyang fell on the twelfth day of the ninth month of 668, after which the country was divided into nine protectorates, forty-two prefectures and one hundred counties; seven years separate the defeat of 661 from the fall of the city. Fifth, geography and distance: Ansi lay on the road from Pyongyang southwest to Liao-dong, and its exact site has two rival identifications, one in the Liao-dong region, the other around Anseong and Jinan in Chungcheongnam-do below the Han river; Pyongyang stood on the lower Yalu more than five hundred li from Liao-dong city; the sea route ran from Dengzhou and Laizhou, a few days' sail in a fair wind to Kumgang, but with contrary wind and ice no distance at all. Sixth, the cost in time: the success of a siege was never a question of the craft of the assault, but of whether the grain ships could complete one round trip before the winter.
cause: 打起來的緣由要從兩年前的一次勝利說起。顯慶五年（六百六十年），唐高宗命蘇定方率軍滅百濟，唐軍以十三萬之眾渡海入朝鮮半島，擊滅泗洲，俘百濟王扶餘豐，封高句麗的寶藏王高藏為高麗王，唐廷在熊津設都督府，把半島南部納入版圖。這一戰之後，唐廷以為只要再平掉高句麗，半島問題便可一次解決。百濟的舊民不肯接受，顯慶六年正月，扶餘隆自稱百濟王，與高句麗及渾比興、高延等合流，攻陷突城、道城、熊津諸城，唐軍在半島上的據點被連根拔起，這等於高句麗在背後撐腰。直接的理由是守住熊津與平壤：熊津是唐軍在半島的基地，丟了熊津，平壤就暴露，而平壤正是唐廷選定的下一步目標。深一層的理由是唐朝的戰略慣性：太宗三次征遼東沒有拿下高句麗，高宗不想讓這件事在第二代人的手裡結束，於是趁新羅求援、百濟復國的混亂，企圖用一次成功的圍城解決整個半島。遠征一旦超出海岸線數百里，便要靠海運把糧食從山東半島運到鴨綠水，再轉陸路進軍；這條線能不能在冬季維持，決定的是出兵與否，而不是有多少兵。
causeEn: The reason for the war must be read back from a victory two years earlier. In the fifth year of Xianqing (660) Emperor Gaozong sent Su Dingfang to destroy Baekje; a hundred and thirty thousand Tang troops crossed the sea onto the Korean peninsula, broke Sizhou, captured Buyeo Pung, king of Baekje, invested the Goguryeo king Gochang as king of Goguryeo, and set up a protectorate at Kumgang, folding the southern half of the peninsula into the empire. After that the court believed that a single blow against Goguryeo would settle the peninsula once and for all. The old people of Baekje would not accept it: in the first month of the sixth year of Xianqing, Buyeo Long proclaimed himself king of Baekje, joined hands with Goguryeo and with Hun Biseong and Go Yeon, and took Tucheng, Daocheng and Kumgang, uprooting the Tang footholds on the peninsula, which was Goguryeo backing the rising from behind. The immediate object was to hold Kumgang and Pyongyang: Kumgang was the Tang base on the peninsula, once it was lost Pyongyang lay open, and Pyongyang was the next step the court had chosen. The deeper reason was the strategic habit of the Tang: Taizong had failed three times to take Liao-dong, and Gaozong did not want the business left unfinished in the second generation, so amid the confusion of the Silla appeal and the Baekje rising he meant to settle the whole peninsula with a single successful siege. Once an expedition pushed several hundred li beyond the coast it had to feed itself by shipping grain from the Shandong peninsula to the Yalu and marching inland; whether that line could be held through the winter decided whether the army marched at all, not how many men it had.
impact: 這場敗仗的後果，遠大於一場圍城的成敗。第一，唐朝在東北亞的攻勢全面收縮。咸亨元年正月，高宗下詔罷兵，撤回平壤與熊津的軍隊，把安市等城邑歸還高句麗，承認六百六十年的勝利只是暫時的。從此到六百六十七年李勣重新集兵，中間近六年的空檔；六年裡高句麗得以重整防務、恢復戶口，重新向新羅與百濟殘部施加壓力。第二，東亞三國的格局被推向另一個方向：高句麗活了下來，新羅在唐軍撤出之後失去靠山，被迫單獨面對北方壓力；百濟的復國在六百六十三年的白江口被唐羅聯軍擊潰，扶餘隆被俘，百濟再覆，但這一役已讓唐廷明白，半島的事一次解決不了。第三，戰術教訓被寫進制度裡：遠征兵力的上限不取決於名冊上的兵員，而取決於海運的噸位與季節，事後看安市之敗並非唐軍不會攻城，而是唐軍在錯誤的季節打了一場必須靠糧船維持的戰爭，糧道一斷，全線崩解。第四，事件把契苾何力這類蕃部將領推到前線最顯眼的位置，鐵勒騎兵在東北的機動能力、鐵勒部眾的忠誠問題，隨後成為唐朝內部另一條麻煩線。第五，六年後的平壤陷落說明一切：唐朝終於走到了六百六十一年沒有走完的那一步，但要走到那一步，它先得在六百六十二年把整個戰區退回海岸。
impactEn: The consequences of this defeat reached far beyond the fate of one siege. First, the Tang offensive in north-east Asia contracted on every front. In the first month of Xianheng (662) Gaozong ordered the troops disbanded, recalled the garrisons of Pyongyang and Kumgang, and returned Ansi and the other towns to Goguryeo, conceding that the victory of 660 had been temporary. From then until Li Ji mustered his army again in 667 there lay a gap of nearly six years, and in those years Goguryeo could restore its defences, recover its households and resume its pressure on Silla and on the surviving Baekje. Second, the balance of the three states in East Asia was pushed in another direction: Goguryeo survived, and Silla, once the Tang withdrew, lost its protector and had to face the northern pressure alone; the Baekje rising was crushed at Baekgang in 663, when the Tang and Silla forces destroyed the Baekje and Japanese coalition and took Buyeo Long prisoner, but the episode had already shown the Tang court that the peninsula could not be settled in a single stroke. Third, the tactical lesson was written into institutions: the ceiling of an expedition's strength is set not by the numbers on the roster but by the tonnage of the shipping and by the season; looking back, the defeat at Ansi was not a failure of siegecraft but a war fought in the wrong season, one that had to be sustained by grain ships, and once the line was cut the whole front came apart. Fourth, the campaign pushed commanders of the frontier tribes such as Qibi Heli into the most visible place on the front, and the mobility of the Tiele horse and the loyalty of the Tiele tribes became another troublesome line inside the Tang. Fifth, the fall of Pyongyang six years later says everything: the Tang finally took the step they had not finished in 661, but to take it they first had to pull the whole theatre back to the coast in 662.
result: 點完：唐軍沒有拿下安市，圍城以撤退收場。糧道被雪封住之後，契苾何力等率軍退往海岸，士卒在途中僵凍而死者過半，攻城器械與輜重盡數遺棄；高句麗的援軍與百濟的游騎在退路上追擊，唐軍用人命換回來的只是主力回營。安市城沒有被攻破，高句麗保住了平壤與平壤道的前哨，唐朝在半島南部失去熊津，在遼東也退到海岸線以內。戰役的真正結果要到六百六十八年才寫下：那年李勣率軍十五萬南下，先拔新城、扶餘城諸處，六百六十八年九月平壤城破，高句麗亡，唐置安東都護府，分其地為九都督府、四十二州、一百縣，最初由薛仁貴統兵二萬鎮守。換句話說，六百六十一年的平壤之戰不是唐軍攻陷平壤的一場戰鬥，而是唐朝整整七年後才補上的一課：這場仗決定了誰能先把兵送過去、把糧運到、再把兵帶回來。
resultEn: When it was over, the Tang had not taken Ansi, and the siege ended in a withdrawal. Once the supply line was sealed by snow, Qibi Heli and his colleagues pulled the army back toward the coast, more than half the soldiers froze to death on the road, and the siege engines and baggage were abandoned; the Korean relief troops and the Baekje raiders followed the column and harried it, and the lives the Tang spent bought back only the main body. The city of Ansi was not breached, Goguryeo kept the outpost of Pyongyang and the Pyongyang road, the Tang lost Kumgang in the south of the peninsula and withdrew inside the coastline in Liao-dong as well. The real result of the campaign was not written down until 668: in that year Li Ji led one hundred and fifty thousand men south, took Xincheng and Fuyu among the other strongholds, and in the ninth month of 668 Pyongyang fell, ending Goguryeo; the Tang set up the Andong protectorate, divided the country into nine protectorates, forty-two prefectures and one hundred counties, and Xue Rengui was given two thousand men to garrison it. In other words, the Pyongyang campaign of 661 was not a battle in which the Tang stormed the city; it was the lesson the Tang took seven years later. That campaign decided who could get troops there first, who could feed them, and who could bring them back again.
